The '''invasion of Utapau''' was the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]'s invasion of the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[Planet|world]] of [[Utapau]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Utapau has long been a target of the Separatists. Dooku and Grievous haven't been able to make inroads with the Pau'ans or the Utai, but if they can enlist the Amani to revolt from within, that could cause dangerous civil unrest.|Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="A Death on Utapau">{{TCW|A Death on Utapau}}</ref>}}
[[Utapau]] was a [[planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Ultimate SW">''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''</ref> that was a target for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], though they failed to reach settlements with the [[Utapaun]]s who lived there.<ref name="A Death on Utapau" /> Towards the end of the [[Clone Wars]],<ref name="Ultimate SW" /> the Separatists arranged for an [[Mission to Utapau|arms deal]] with [[Amani]] [[arms dealer]]s for a massive [[kyber crystal]] on Utapau,<ref name="Crystal Crisis">{{TCW|Crystal Crisis}}</ref> but [[Jedi General]]s [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker]] became involved after [[Jedi Master]] [[Tu-Anh]]'s investigation ended in her [[death]].<ref name="A Death on Utapau" /> [[Supreme Martial Commander of the Separatist Droid Armies|Supreme Commander]]<ref name="Character Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded]]''</ref> [[General]] [[Grievous]] arrived to oversee the arms deal, receiving help from [[Governor]] [[Torul Blom]] and other [[Utapaun Committee|Utapaun officials]].<ref name="Crystal Crisis" /> Ultimately, however, the mission ended with Kenobi and Skywalker destroying the [[crystal]] over Utapau.<ref name="Big Bang">{{TCW|The Big Bang}}</ref> Nevertheless, the chance that other large kyber [[crystal]]s were on planet necessitated a search and occupation of the otherwise peaceful Utapau, as the [[Sith Lord]] [[Darth Sidious]] wanted such crystals for his [[Project Stardust|battlestation project]].<ref name="Helmet Collection 35">{{HelmetCollectionCite|35|Highlights of the Saga}}</ref>

==The invasion==
Within [[Standard month|months]] of the arms deal,<ref name="Helmet Collection 61">{{HelmetCollectionCite|61|Databank A-Z}}</ref> the Separatists invaded the planet<ref name="Grievous wheel bike" /> after Grievous decided that Utapau could serve as a hiding place for the [[Executive Separatist Council]].<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> Grievous<ref name="Grievous wheel bike" /> and thousands of [[battle droid]]s<ref name="Collapse" /> served in the invasion. During the incursion, Grievous's preferred vehicle was a [[TSMEU-6 personal wheel bike]].<ref name="Grievous wheel bike" /> The Separatists conquered the native population of [[Pau'an]]s and [[Utai]], as they peacefully submitted to Confederate rule<ref name="SWEUtapau" /> and were held hostage by an ensuing [[Confederacy military|military]] occupation.<ref name="ROTS" /> At some point after the Separatists arrived, [[IG-100 MagnaGuard]]s slaughtered the members of [[Port Administrator]] [[Tion Medon]]'s committee, an action that Medon witnessed and was horrified by.<ref name="CVD" />

==Aftermath==
===Confederate occupation===
[[File:Sep_council.png|thumb|left|250px|After the invasion, the Separatist Council gained a base on the subjugated Utapau.]]
Occupied by Confederate leadership to serve as a sanctuary,<ref name="CVD" /> Utapau became a base-of-operations for the constantly moving Separatist Council,<ref name="SWEUtapau" /> just as Grievous decided it should be.<ref name="Complete Locations" /> A [[Unidentified core ship|converted core ship]] on [[Level 10]] became the Separatist command center on the planet.<ref name="SWEUtapau" /> Additionally, Grievous's invading forces built command centers and self-replicating [[Techno Union]] factories, which constructed new [[starfighter]]s, [[troop]]s, wheel bikes, and other vehicles using Utapau's material resources. If they were left undisturbed, these facilities could have turned Utapau into another Separatist [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[fortress world]].<ref name="Complete Vehicles 2018">[[Star Wars: Complete Vehicles (2018)|''Star Wars: Complete Vehicles'' (2018)]]</ref>

The Utapauns were only feigning acceptance of Separatist rule, as they also secretly preparing to rebel against their occupiers.<ref name="CVD" /> After the invasion, however, the Utai of [[Pau City]] needed to work on their hidden starfighters in secret.<ref name="Complete Vehicles 2018" /> All the while, Separatist [[Mankvim-814 light interceptor]]s flocked to Utaptau, where the Techno Union hastily built new factories in the [[Grand Hall of the Traders' Guild]]—paying no regard to the world's local aesthetic design in the process—that constructed further Makvim-814s out of local material.<ref name="Complete New">''[[Star Wars Complete Vehicles, New Edition]]''</ref>

===Short-lived liberation===
{{Main|Battle of Utapau}}
During the final [[Standard day|days]] of the war, [[Sith Lord]] [[Darth Sidious]] ordered major Confederate leaders to gather at Utapau.<ref name="Ultimate SW" /> However, following the [[Battle of Coruscant]]<ref name="ROTS" /> and an elite [[Clone Intelligence]] unit intercepting a diplomatic packet from the [[Utapau system]]'s [[chairman]],<ref name="SWEUtapau" /> the [[Jedi High Council]] dispatched General Kenobi to confirm if Grievous was on the planet. Though Kenobi managed to kill Grievous during the ensuing [[Battle of Utapau|Republic assault]],<ref name="ROTS" /> the [[clone trooper]]s who arrived with the [[Jedi]] [[Occupation of Utapau|occupied]] the planet and rounded up the [[Utapaun Security Forces]].<ref name="SWEUtapau" />

==Behind the scenes==
The reference magazine [[Star Wars Bust Collection 68|''Star Wars Bust Collection'' 68]] claims that Grievous was present on Utapau for several weeks after the Battle of Coruscant.<ref name="BC 68 Tion">{{BustCollectionCite|68|Character}}</ref> However, only a few days pass<ref name="On the Front Lines">''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]''</ref><ref name="The Phantom Apprentice">{{TCW|The Phantom Apprentice}}</ref><ref name="Shattered">{{TCW|Shattered}}</ref> between the Battle of Coruscant and liberation of Utapau, not several weeks.<ref name="ROTS" />
